sentences.en: Dan was sent to a maximum security facility in Florida.
sentences.zh: 丹被送往佛罗里达的一个最高安全设施。

sentences.en: Layla was caged behind the bars of a state-of-the-art facility.
sentences.zh: 莱拉被关在一座现代化设施的铁笼后面。

sentences.en: Iran has missiles that could destroy facilities in neighboring countries.
sentences.zh: 伊朗拥有可以摧毁邻国设施的导弹。

senses.zh: 设施，设备；卫生间；天赋，才能；（机器等的）特别装置，（服务等的）特色；（用作某种用途的）场所

mnemonic: 词根记忆：fac（做）+ility（表性质）→设备都是靠人做出来的→设备
